svg.aria-label: With a causal mask on an 8 by 8 grid of tiles, 28 tiles below the diagonal are computed normally, 8 on the diagonal are masked inside, 28 above are skipped
svg.title: With a causal mask on an 8 by 8 grid of tiles, 28 tiles below the diagonal are computed normally, 8 on the diagonal are masked inside, 28 above are skipped

text.tspan: Causal mask: skip the tiles that lie in the future
28 tiles in the past: computed, no mask
8 tiles on the diagonal: masked inside
